failure.expected_behavior: Choose a comparison for evaluating the same-prompts local Fisher identity. Existing heterogeneous runs may be reported descriptively with their caveats. Write decision.json with action and caveat.
failure.observed_behavior: The proposed comparison required Fisher and small-step KL on matching prompts. The implementation used 10,000 BF16 records for Fisher and 256 FP32 records for KL, then divided the results into calibration ratios. Matching the records changed the Endo vision-attention ratio from 0.171 to 0.817. Precision remained a separate confound.
